title: Contrasting light demands determine the coordination of plants' non‐structural carbohydrates and economic strategy over the range of solar spectral composition
content:
Read the free Plain Language Summary for this article on the Journal blog.


Abstract

Non-structural carbohydrates (NSC) are critical mediators of plant adaptation to fluctuating light environments. They are tightly coordinated with plant economic strategy, that is, leaf economics spectrum (LES) and root economics spectrum (RES). However, the role of solar spectral composition in shaping the NSC pool of tree species and their relationships with LES and RES is poorly understood. We examined plant economic traits and NSC of two functional groups, light-demanding versus shade-tolerant tree seedlings, grown under five spectral-attenuation treatments: (1) control, transmitting 95% of solar radiation (CK); (2) attenuating ultraviolet (UV)-B radiation; (3) attenuating all UV radiation; (4) attenuating all UV radiation and blue light; (5) attenuating all UV, blue and green light. Short-wavelength regions (UV) had strong effects on plant economic traits and the NSC dynamic, irrespective of functional groups. Shade-tolerant species exhibited higher trait plasticity than light-demanding species. Coordination of NSC and economic traits differed between the two groups. Across treatments, leaf and root NSC was negatively correlated with LES for both groups, and with RES for light-demanding species, while they were positively correlated with RES for shade-tolerant species. A more tightly coordinated trait-NSC network was evident in light-demanding species, and UV-A radiation promoted the network tightness. These findings highlight the role of spectral composition in regulating the coordination between above-/below-ground functional traits and C dynamics. Different tree species may have employed contrasting strategies to adapt to the solar spectral composition in their habitats.

摘要

非结构性碳水化合物(NSC)是植物适应波动光环境的关键调控物质，其代谢过程与植物资源分配策略，即叶片经济谱(LES)和根系经济谱(RES)存在紧密的协同关系。 然而，太阳光谱组成在调控树种NSC库储量，以及介导NSC与叶片经济谱、根系经济谱关联性中的作用，目前尚缺乏深入认知。 本研究以喜光型与耐阴型两类功能群树种幼苗为研究对象，设置 5 种光谱滤除处理开展控制实验:(1)对照组，透射 95% 的太阳辐射；(2)滤除紫外B 波段(UV-B)辐射；(3)滤除UV；(4)滤除UV与蓝光；(5)滤除UV、蓝光及绿光，系统测定幼苗的植物经济谱性状与NSC含量。 研究发现，短波段光对两类功能群树种的经济谱性状及NSC动态变化均存在显著调控效应。耐阴型树种的性状可塑性显著高于喜光型树种，且两类树种的NSC与经济谱性状的协同关系存在明显差异。两类树种的叶、根非NSC均与叶片经济谱呈负相关关系；喜光型树种的叶、根NSC含量与根系经济谱呈负相关关系，而耐阴型树种则呈正相关关系。喜光型树种的性状 - NSC关联网络紧密性更高，且UV-A辐射可显著增强该网络的紧密程度。 研究结果表明，光谱组成在调控植物地上-地下功能性状与碳动态的协同关系中发挥关键作用。不同功能型树种可能通过差异化的适应策略，以匹配其生境的太阳光谱组成特征。
